1. Extend the image at the right and bottom so that its size is a multiple of the grid.
2. Count the histogram of the levels in each tile.
3. Turn each tile histogram into a curve, 255 / M times its running total, rounded.
4. For each pixel, blend the curves of the four nearest tile centers bilinearly and apply the blend to the pixel's value.
